135 def proceed_on_silence_sweep(now=None):
136     """On the server's reconcile tick: every steward whose saved decision is reversible, carries an
137     undo and a recommendation, and has waited SILENCE_SECONDS proceeds - a sleeping steward wakes
138     for it. Returns the campaign dirs that proceeded."""
139     from steward_cockpit.steward_engine import _read_all_state, SILENCE_SECONDS
140     now = time.time() if now is None else now
141     done = []
142     for key, entry in _read_all_state().items():
143         if "||general||" in key or not isinstance(entry, dict):
144             continue
145         q = entry.get("question_context")
146         if not isinstance(q, dict) or q.get("reversible") is not True or not q.get("undo") or not q.get("recommendation"):
147             continue
148         asked = q.get("asked_at")
149         if not isinstance(asked, (int, float)) or isinstance(asked, bool) or now - asked < SILENCE_SECONDS:
150             continue
151         eng = get_engine(key)
152         if eng is None:
153             continue
154         try:
155             if eng.proceed_on_silence(q.get("id"), now=now).get("ok"):
156                 done.append(key)
157         except Exception:
158             continue
159     return done

162 def get_engine(cdir, general=False, tid=None, create=True):
163     if general:
164         tid = str(tid or "1")
165         if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{1,6}", tid):
166             return None
167         if create and tid not in _load_terms(cdir):
168             return None
169     key = cdir + (f"||general||{tid}" if general else "")
170     with ENGINES_LOCK:
171         if key not in ENGINES:
172             if not create:
173                 return None
174             if sum(1 for e in ENGINES.values() if e.alive()) >= MAX_LIVE_ENGINES:
175                 return None
176             ENGINES[key] = Engine(cdir, permission_mode=CONFIG["permission_mode"],
177                                   fake=CONFIG["fake"], steward=CONFIG["steward"],
178                                   general=general, tid=tid if general else None)
179         return ENGINES[key]

182 def rename_stewards(label):
183     """The persona changed (2026-10-05, his word: the persona is not what the steward knows - switching it must never
184     look like forgetting): every live steward takes the new name for its next wake and its page labels. Storage never
185     depended on it (state, logs and engines are keyed by folder); only this cached name lagged."""
186     label = str(label or "").strip()
187     if not label:
188         return 0
189     CONFIG["steward"] = label
190     n = 0
191     with ENGINES_LOCK:
192         for eng in ENGINES.values():
193             if getattr(eng, "steward", None) != label:
194                 eng.steward = label
195                 n += 1
196     return n

350 def api_get(proot, verb, qs):
351     if qs.get("general") == "1" and not (qs.get("dir") or "").strip():
352         if verb in _GENERAL_READ_VERBS:
353             if not _registered_project_terminal(proot, qs.get("term")):
354                 return {"error": "no such project terminal"}, 404
355             return events(proot, qs) if verb == "events" else handle_get(proot, verb, qs)
356     if verb == "events":
357         cdir = _effort_dir(proot, qs.get("dir", ""))
358         if cdir is None:
359             return {"error": "unknown effort"}, 404
360         return events(cdir, qs)
361     if verb in _PROJECT_VERBS or verb in ("terms",) or verb in _PROJECT_FILE_VERBS:
362         rel = (qs.get("dir") or "").strip()
363         if verb in _PROJECT_FILE_VERBS and rel:
364             cdir = _effort_dir(proot, rel)
365             if cdir is None:
366                 return {"error": "unknown effort"}, 404
367             return handle_get(cdir, verb, qs)
368         return handle_get(proot, verb, qs)
369     cdir = _effort_dir(proot, qs.get("dir", ""))
370     if cdir is None:
371         return {"error": "unknown effort"}, 404
372     return handle_get(cdir, verb, qs)

386 def api_post(proot, verb, body):
387     if verb in ("new_effort", "boneyard_restore", "boneyard_move",
388                 "rename_effort"):
389         return _project_post(proot, verb, body)
390     rel = (body.get("dir") or "").strip()
391     if not rel and verb in _PROJECT_TERMINAL_VERBS:
392         return handle_post(proot, verb, body)
393     if not rel and body.get("general") is True and verb in _GENERAL_POST_VERBS:
394         if not _registered_project_terminal(proot, body.get("term")):
395             return {"ok": False, "error": "no such project terminal"}, 404
396         if body.get("refinement_context"):
397             return {"ok": False, "error": "refinement belongs to its campaign"}, 400
398         return handle_post(proot, verb, body)
399     if verb in _PROJECT_FILE_VERBS and not rel:
400         return handle_post(proot, verb, body)
401     cdir = _effort_dir(proot, body.get("dir", ""))
402     if cdir is None:
403         return {"ok": False, "error": "unknown effort"}, 404
404     return handle_post(cdir, verb, body)

407 def _project_post(proot, verb, body):
408     if verb == "new_effort":
409         return _new_effort(proot, body)
410     if verb == "boneyard_restore":
411         name = Path(str(body.get("name", ""))).name
412         if not re.fullmatch(r"[\w\- ]{1,60}", name):
413             return {"ok": False, "error": "bad name"}, 400
414         src = Path(proot) / BONEYARD / name
415         dst = Path(proot) / name
416         # resting in place (marker) → resurrect by removing the marker
417         if (dst / "ECGBERHT.md").is_file() and campaign.is_retired_in_place(str(dst)):
418             campaign.resurrect_in_place(str(dst))
419             return {"ok": True, "rel": name, "in_place": True}, 200
420         if not (src / "ECGBERHT.md").is_file():
421             return {"ok": False, "error": "not in the boneyard"}, 404
422         if dst.exists():
423             return {"ok": False, "error": "a live effort already has that name"}, 409
424         src.rename(dst)
425         return {"ok": True, "rel": name}, 200
426     if verb == "rename_effort":
427         # Effort names are the USER'S to set (John, 2026-08-25) — this is the
428         # sanctioned rename path: stops the effort's engines cleanly (refusing
429         # mid-turn), renames the dir, migrates the engine-state keys so usage
430         # and saved sessions follow. The model-side CLI session cannot resume
431         # across a cwd change, so the steward stands back up from the record.
432         rel = body.get("dir", "")
433         if not rel:
434             return {"ok": False, "error":
435                     "the project root is renamed in Anchor, not here"}, 400
436         cdir = _effort_dir(proot, rel)
437         if cdir is None:
438             return {"ok": False, "error": "unknown effort"}, 404
439         name, err = _validate_effort_name(body.get("name", ""))
440         if err:
441             return {"ok": False, "error": err}, 400
442         dst = Path(proot) / name
443         if dst.exists():
444             return {"ok": False, "error": "an effort already has that name"}, 409
445         with ENGINES_LOCK:
446             keys = [k for k in ENGINES if k == cdir or k.startswith(cdir + "||")]
447             if any(ENGINES[k].alive() and (ENGINES[k].busy or ENGINES[k].queue)
448                    for k in keys):
449                 return {"ok": False, "error":
450                         "finish or pause the current turn before renaming"}, 409
451             engs = [ENGINES.pop(k) for k in keys]
452         for e in engs:
453             try:
454                 e.stop()
455             except Exception:
456                 pass
457         try:
458             Path(cdir).rename(dst)
459         except OSError as e:
460             return {"ok": False, "error": f"could not rename: {e}"}, 500
461         try:
462             from steward_cockpit.steward_engine import rename_state_keys
463             rename_state_keys(cdir, str(dst))
464         except Exception:
465             pass
466         return {"ok": True, "rel": name}, 200
467     if verb == "boneyard_move":
468         rel = body.get("dir", "")
469         if not rel:
470             return {"ok": False, "error": "the project root cannot be boneyarded"}, 400
471         cdir = _effort_dir(proot, rel)
472         if cdir is None:
473             return {"ok": False, "error": "unknown effort"}, 404
474         with ENGINES_LOCK:
475             keys = [k for k in ENGINES if k == cdir or k.startswith(cdir + "||")]
476             engs = [ENGINES.pop(k) for k in keys]
477         for e in engs:
478             try:
479                 e.stop()
480             except Exception:
481                 pass
482         yard = Path(proot) / BONEYARD
483         yard.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
484         dst = yard / Path(cdir).name
485         if dst.exists():
486             return {"ok": False, "error": "name collision in the boneyard"}, 409
487         # (2026-09-03, John: "there was an error archiving") Windows refuses
488         # the rename while anything inside is open — a deck in PowerPoint, an
489         # Explorer window, a terminal's cwd, the engine we just stopped still
490         # letting go. Retry briefly; if it still refuses, retire IN PLACE
491         # (marker) — the effort leaves the live list and joins the boneyard
492         # exactly as if moved, and nothing is lost.
493         last = None
494         for _i in range(5):
495             try:
496                 Path(cdir).rename(dst)
497                 return {"ok": True, "in_place": False}, 200
498             except OSError as e:
499                 last = e
500                 time.sleep(0.4)
501         try:
502             campaign.retire_in_place(cdir, "folder in use at retire time: %s" % last)
503         except OSError as e:
504             return {"ok": False, "error": f"could not archive: {e}"}, 500
505         return {"ok": True, "in_place": True,
506                 "note": "retired in place — a file in it was open, so the folder "
507                         "stayed where it is; it rests in the boneyard all the same"}, 200
508     return {"ok": False, "error": "unknown"}, 404

531                     "touched": campaign.last_touched(edir),

541             "usage": _usage_rollup(cdir), "efforts": out,
542             "other_recorded_usage": _other_recorded_usage(cdir),

546 def _other_recorded_usage(cdir):
547     """Expose saved run records separately; their overlap with cockpit usage is unknown."""
548     import json
549     import math
550 
551     result = {
552         "scope": "separate run records; may overlap cockpit history",
553         "status": "available", "records": [], "duplicate_count": 0,
554         "conflict_count": 0, "unavailable_sources": [], "project_aliases": [],
555     }
556 
557     def unavailable(source, project_id=None, lane=None):
558         item = {"source": source, "status": "unavailable"}
559         if project_id is not None:
560             item["project_id"] = project_id
561         if lane is not None:
562             item["lane"] = lane
563         result["unavailable_sources"].append(item)
564 
565     def nonnegative(value, integer=False):
566         if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
567             return None
568         try:
569             if not math.isfinite(value) or value < 0 or (integer and int(value) != value):
570                 return None
571         except (OverflowError, ValueError):
572             return None
573         return int(value) if integer else float(value)
574 
575     try:
576         import effort_history as eh
577     except Exception:
578         unavailable("effort-history-import")
579         result["status"] = "unavailable"
580         return result
581     try:
582         import rnd_registry
583         projects = rnd_registry.list_projects()
584         if not isinstance(projects, (list, tuple)):
585             raise ValueError("invalid registry result")
586     except Exception:
587         unavailable("project-registry")
588         result["status"] = "unavailable"
589         return result
590 
591     try:
592         target = os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(cdir))
593     except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
594         unavailable("project-scope")
595         result["status"] = "unavailable"
596         return result
597     aliases = {}
598     for project in projects:
599         if not isinstance(project, dict):
600             continue
601         folder = project.get("folder_path")
602         project_id = project.get("id")
603         if not isinstance(folder, str) or not folder.strip() or not isinstance(project_id, str) or not project_id:
604             continue
605         try:
606             matches = os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(folder)) == target
607         except (OSError, ValueError):
608             matches = False
609         if matches:
610             name = project.get("name")
611             aliases[project_id] = {"id": project_id, "name": name[:160] if isinstance(name, str) else project_id}
612     result["project_aliases"] = [aliases[key] for key in sorted(aliases)]
613     groups = {}
614     for project_id in sorted(aliases):
615         for lane in eh.ROLLUP_LANES:
616             try:
617                 records = eh.list_efforts(cdir, project_id, lane)
618                 if not isinstance(records, (list, tuple)):
619                     raise ValueError("invalid effort history")
620             except Exception:
621                 unavailable("effort-history", project_id, lane)
622                 continue
623             for record in records:
624                 if not isinstance(record, dict):
625                     unavailable("effort-history-record", project_id, lane)
626                     continue
627                 try:
628                     discovered = eh.is_discovered(record)
629                 except Exception:
630                     unavailable("effort-history-record", project_id, lane)
631                     continue
632                 if discovered:
633                     continue
634                 cost = record.get("cost")
635                 cost = cost if isinstance(cost, dict) else {}
636                 if not cost and record.get("kind") != "run-cost":
637                     continue
638                 cost_context = {field: cost.get(field, record.get(field))
639                                 for field in ("cost_state", "billing_mode", "cost_complete")}
640                 try:
641                     # Different billing context must not disappear when equal saved
642                     # dollar amounts are deduplicated, especially legacy zeros.
643                     payload = json.dumps({"cost": cost, "context": cost_context}, sort_keys=True,
644                                          separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
645                 except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
646                     unavailable("effort-history-cost", project_id, lane)
647                     continue
648                 identity_type, identity = None, None
649                 for field in ("engine_session_uuid", "session_id", "job_id"):
650                     value = record.get(field)
651                     if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
652                         identity_type, identity = field, value
653                         break
654                 identity_key = (identity_type, identity) if identity is not None else None
655                 group = groups.setdefault(identity_key, []) if identity_key is not None else []
656                 duplicate = next((row for saved_payload, row in group if saved_payload == payload), None)
657                 if duplicate is not None:
658                     if project_id not in duplicate["project_ids"]:
659                         duplicate["project_ids"].append(project_id)
660                     if lane not in duplicate["lanes"]:
661                         duplicate["lanes"].append(lane)
662                     result["duplicate_count"] += 1
663                     continue
664                 saved_usd = nonnegative(cost.get("total_cost_usd"))
665                 cost_state = cost.get("cost_state", record.get("cost_state"))
666                 billing_mode = cost.get("billing_mode", record.get("billing_mode"))
667                 cost_complete = cost.get("cost_complete", record.get("cost_complete"))
668                 has_cost_context = (
669                     isinstance(cost_state, str) and bool(cost_state.strip()) or
670                     isinstance(billing_mode, str) and bool(billing_mode.strip()) or
671                     isinstance(cost_complete, bool)
672                 )
673                 zero_unverified = saved_usd == 0 and not has_cost_context
674                 cost_status = "unavailable" if saved_usd is None else (
675                     "zero_requires_verification" if zero_unverified else
676                     "partial" if cost_complete is False else "recorded")
677                 label = record.get("label")
678                 title = " ".join(label.split())[:160] if isinstance(label, str) and label.strip() else str(lane) + " run"
679                 row = {
680                     "title": title, "lane": lane, "lanes": [lane], "project_ids": [project_id],
681                     "identity_type": identity_type, "identity": identity,
682                     "tokens": nonnegative(cost.get("total_tokens"), integer=True),
683                     "saved_usd": saved_usd, "cost_status": cost_status,
684                     "cost_zero_requires_verification": zero_unverified,
685                     "source": "effort-history", "conflict": bool(group),
686                 }
687                 created_at = nonnegative(record.get("created_at"))
688                 if created_at is not None:
689                     row["created_at"] = created_at
690                 if group:
691                     if not any(previous["conflict"] for _, previous in group):
692                         result["conflict_count"] += 1
693                     for _, previous in group:
694                         previous["conflict"] = True
695                 if identity_key is not None:
696                     group.append((payload, row))
697                 result["records"].append(row)
698     if result["unavailable_sources"]:
699         result["status"] = "partial" if result["records"] else "unavailable"
700     return result
701

703 def _usage_rollup(cdir, estate=None):
704     numeric_fields = ("reported_spend", "unpriced_turns", "estimated_spend", "estimated_turns", "tokens", "secs")
705     coverage_fields = ("tracked_invocations", "reported_invocations", "partial_invocations",
706                        "unavailable_invocations", "finalized_invocations")
707     def zero():
708         return {"reported_spend": 0.0, "unpriced_turns": 0, "estimated_spend": 0.0, "estimated_turns": 0, "tokens": 0, "secs": 0,
709                 "checkpoint_coverage": {field: 0 for field in coverage_fields},
710                 "usage_updated_at": None, "_cost_known": 0, "_cost_unknown": 0,
711                 "_tokens_known": 0, "_tokens_unknown": 0, "_tokens_partial": 0,
712                 "_sub_unpriced": 0, "_other_unpriced": 0, "_sub_clis": []}
713     def number(value):
714         return isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool) and 0 <= value < float("inf")
715     from steward_cockpit.steward_engine import (
716         _read_all_state, _usage_snapshot, fmt_usage_cost_text, infer_subscription_cli)
717     if estate is None:
718         estate = _read_all_state()
719     stew, term = zero(), zero()
720     cdir_n = os.path.realpath(cdir)
721     for key, entry in estate.items():
722         base = os.path.realpath(key.split("||")[0])
723         # exact boundary, not a string prefix: '.../foo' must not match '.../foobar'
724         if base != cdir_n and not base.startswith(cdir_n + os.sep):
725             continue
726         raw = entry.get("usage")
727         u = _usage_snapshot(raw)
728         b = term if "||general||" in key else stew
729         for field in numeric_fields:
730             b[field] += u[field]
731         coverage = u.get("checkpoint_coverage") or {}
732         for field in coverage_fields:
733             value = coverage.get(field)
734             if number(value):
735                 b["checkpoint_coverage"][field] += value
736         updated = u.get("usage_updated_at")
737         if isinstance(updated, str) and updated:
738             b["usage_updated_at"] = max(b["usage_updated_at"] or updated, updated)
739         raw = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
740         activity = any(number(u.get(field)) and u[field] > 0 for field in numeric_fields)
741         activity = activity or (number(coverage.get("tracked_invocations")) and coverage["tracked_invocations"] > 0)
742         active_checkpoints = (number(coverage.get("tracked_invocations")) and
743                               number(coverage.get("finalized_invocations")) and
744                               coverage["tracked_invocations"] > coverage["finalized_invocations"])
745         incomplete = (u.get("cost_status") == "partial" or u.get("cost_complete") is False or
746                       u["unpriced_turns"] > 0 or active_checkpoints)
747         explicit_cost = any(number(raw.get(field)) for field in ("spend", "reported_spend"))
748         cost_known = u["reported_spend"] > 0 or (explicit_cost and not incomplete)
749         if u.get("cost_status") == "unavailable":
750             cost_known = False
751         b["_cost_known"] += int(cost_known)
752         b["_cost_unknown"] += int(incomplete or (activity and not cost_known))
753         token_status = u.get("token_status")
754         tokens_known = token_status == "reported" or u["tokens"] > 0 or (
755             token_status == "partial" and number(coverage.get("reported_invocations")) and coverage["reported_invocations"] > 0)
756         if token_status == "unavailable":
757             tokens_known = False
758         b["_tokens_known"] += int(tokens_known)
759         b["_tokens_unknown"] += int(activity and not tokens_known)
760         b["_tokens_partial"] += int(token_status == "partial")
761         family = infer_subscription_cli(entry.get("cli"), raw.get("usage_source") or u.get("usage_source"))
762         if u["unpriced_turns"] > 0:
763             if family:
764                 b["_sub_unpriced"] += u["unpriced_turns"]
765                 if family not in b["_sub_clis"]:
766                     b["_sub_clis"].append(family)
767             else:
768                 b["_other_unpriced"] += u["unpriced_turns"]
769     # (Wave 2 S1) delegated jobs are a source of their own, beside the total the
770     # dashboard already reads as the steward's figure: the rows the seam indexed
771     # for this effort's project, joined by the folder the job ran in (this effort
772     # dir or under it). One small doc per project — never a scan of rnd_jobs or
773     # the ledger on a poll. Shown only when rows exist; "unknown" counts jobs
774     # whose usage never reached us, never a zero.
775     jobs = zero()
776     jobs["count"], jobs["unknown"] = 0, 0
777     # (S2) sub-agents the stewards of this effort spawned: count, tokens, unknown
778     children = zero()
779     children["count"], children["unknown"] = 0, 0
780     # (S3) trio seats the skills of this effort ran: priced, unpriced or unknown, like
781     # jobs; a seat that is a job's own engine session or a recorded child is not
782     # counted twice (the job or the child wins)
783     seats = zero()
784     seats["count"], seats["unknown"] = 0, 0
785     try:
786         import usage_capture as _uc
787         import usage_index as _ui
788         project_id = _uc.resolve_project(cdir)[0]
789         rows = _ui.load_rows(project_id) if project_id else []
790     except Exception:
791         rows = []
792     owned = {row.get("engine_session_uuid") for row in rows
793              if isinstance(row, dict) and row.get("source") == "job" and row.get("engine_session_uuid")}
794     owned |= {row.get("native_id") for row in rows
795               if isinstance(row, dict) and row.get("source") == "subagent" and row.get("native_id")}
796     cdir_c = os.path.normcase(cdir_n)
797     cdir_prefix = cdir_c.rstrip(os.sep) + os.sep
798 
799     def in_scope(scope):
800         return isinstance(scope, str) and (scope == cdir_c or scope.startswith(cdir_prefix))
801     for row in rows:
802         if not isinstance(row, dict):
803             continue
804         if row.get("source") == "subagent":
805             if not in_scope(row.get("scope")):
806                 continue
807             tokens = row.get("tokens")
808             children["count"] += 1
809             if number(tokens):
810                 children["tokens"] += tokens
811             if row.get("usage_state") == "unknown":
812                 children["unknown"] += 1
813                 children["_tokens_unknown"] += 1
814             else:
815                 children["unpriced_turns"] += 1
816                 children["_tokens_known"] += 1
817             children["_cost_unknown"] += 1
818             stamp = row.get("recorded_at")
819             if isinstance(stamp, str) and stamp:
820                 children["usage_updated_at"] = max(children["usage_updated_at"] or stamp, stamp)
821             continue
822         if row.get("source") not in ("job", "seat"):
823             continue
824         # a job that ran in a worktree outside the project folder joins at the
825         # project folder (Grok R1 F2); scopes were stamped at write time (F5)
826         if not (in_scope(row.get("scope")) or in_scope(row.get("folder_scope"))):
827             continue
828         if row.get("source") == "seat" and (row.get("engine_session_uuid") in owned or row.get("native_id") in owned):
829             continue
830         b = jobs if row.get("source") == "job" else seats
831         state, tokens, cost = row.get("usage_state"), row.get("tokens"), row.get("cost_usd")
832         b["count"] += 1
833         if number(tokens):
834             b["tokens"] += tokens
835         if number(row.get("duration_ms")):
836             b["secs"] += row["duration_ms"] / 1000
837         if state == "measured" and number(cost):
838             b["reported_spend"] += cost
839             b["_cost_known"] += 1
840             b["_tokens_known"] += 1
841         elif state == "unpriced":
842             b["unpriced_turns"] += 1
843             b["_cost_unknown"] += 1
844             b["_tokens_known"] += 1
845             family = infer_subscription_cli(row.get("cli"))
846             if family:
847                 b["_sub_unpriced"] += 1
848                 if family not in b["_sub_clis"]:
849                     b["_sub_clis"].append(family)
850             else:
851                 b["_other_unpriced"] += 1
852         else:
853             b["unknown"] += 1
854             b["_cost_unknown"] += 1
855             b["_tokens_unknown"] += 1
856         stamp = row.get("recorded_at")
857         if isinstance(stamp, str) and stamp:
858             b["usage_updated_at"] = max(b["usage_updated_at"] or stamp, stamp)
859     total = zero()
860     for field in numeric_fields + ("_cost_known", "_cost_unknown", "_tokens_known",
861                                    "_tokens_unknown", "_tokens_partial",
862                                    "_sub_unpriced", "_other_unpriced"):
863         total[field] = round(stew[field] + term[field], 4)
864     for field in coverage_fields:
865         total["checkpoint_coverage"][field] = stew["checkpoint_coverage"][field] + term["checkpoint_coverage"][field]
866     total["usage_updated_at"] = max(filter(None, (stew["usage_updated_at"], term["usage_updated_at"])), default=None)
867     clis = []
868     for family in stew["_sub_clis"] + term["_sub_clis"]:
869         if family not in clis:
870             clis.append(family)
871     total["_sub_clis"] = clis
872     private = ("_cost_known", "_cost_unknown", "_tokens_known", "_tokens_unknown",
873                "_tokens_partial", "_sub_unpriced", "_other_unpriced", "_sub_clis")
874     for bucket in (stew, term, jobs, children, seats, total):
875         bucket["reported_spend"] = round(bucket["reported_spend"], 4)
876         bucket["estimated_spend"] = round(bucket["estimated_spend"], 4)
877         bucket["cost_status"] = "unavailable" if not bucket["_cost_known"] else (
878             "partial" if bucket["_cost_unknown"] else "reported")
879         bucket["cost_complete"] = bucket["cost_status"] == "reported"
880         bucket["spend"] = bucket["reported_spend"] if bucket["cost_complete"] else None
881         bucket["token_status"] = "unavailable" if not bucket["_tokens_known"] else (
882             "partial" if bucket["_tokens_unknown"] or bucket["_tokens_partial"] else "reported")
883         bucket["usage_source"] = "persisted session records"
884         bucket["usage_basis"] = "recorded"
885         if bucket["_sub_unpriced"] > 0 and bucket["_other_unpriced"] <= 0:
886             bucket["billing_mode"] = "subscription"
887             families = bucket["_sub_clis"]
888             bucket["billing_family"] = families[0] if len(families) == 1 else "mixed"
889         else:
890             bucket["billing_mode"] = None
891             bucket["billing_family"] = None
892         bucket["cost_text"] = fmt_usage_cost_text(bucket, cli=bucket.get("billing_family"))
893         for field in private:
894             del bucket[field]
895     return {"steward": stew, "terms": term, "jobs": jobs, "children": children, "seats": seats, "total": total}
896

903 def render_brief(proot, rel):
904     """(Wave D1, 2026-09-26) The collaborator's printable brief: goal, path, lead line, waiting on,
905     open decisions, last change. Token-less by design and read-only: no conversation, no file
906     links, no token. None when the effort is not one of the project's discovered efforts."""
907     import html as _html
908     cdir = _effort_dir(proot, rel)
909     if cdir is None:
910         return None
911     m = campaign.read_map(cdir)
912     last = campaign.read_last_status(cdir)
913     focused, _ = campaign._focused_step(m)
914     e = lambda v: _html.escape(str(v or ""), quote=True)
915     marks = {"done": "\u2713", "waiting": "\u2691"}
916     shown = [s for s in m.get("steps") or [] if s.get("status") not in ("parked", "cancelled", "dropped")]
917     rows = []
918     for s in shown:
919         now = focused is not None and s.get("id") == focused.get("id")
920         mark = marks.get(s.get("status"), "\u25cf" if now else "\u00b7")
921         wait = (" \u2014 waiting on " + e(s.get("waiting_on"))) if s.get("waiting_on") else ""
922         rows.append("<li>%s %s%s</li>" % (mark, e(s.get("name")), wait))
923     lead = (last or {}).get("lead_line") or "No status recorded yet"
924     at = (last or {}).get("at") or ""
925     plan = (last or {}).get("plan") or {}
926     waiting = plan.get("waiting_on_you") or (m.get("heartbeat") or {}).get("human_wait") or ""
927     pending = (m.get("heartbeat") or {}).get("pending_request") or {}
928     decisions = []
929     if pending.get("purpose"):
930         decisions.append(pending["purpose"])
931     reviews = (m.get("attention") or {}).get("pending_requests") or []
932     if reviews:
933         decisions.append("%d deliverable%s awaiting review" % (len(reviews), "" if len(reviews) == 1 else "s"))
934     return ("<!doctype html><html lang=\"en\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><meta name=\"robots\" content=\"noindex\">"
935         "<title>%s \u00b7 brief</title>"
936         "<style>body{font:15px/1.5 Georgia,serif;max-width:760px;margin:40px auto;padding:0 20px;color:#222}"
937         "h1{font-size:24px;margin:0 0 4px}h2{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#666;margin:26px 0 6px}"
938         "ul{padding-left:18px;margin:0}li{list-style:none;margin:3px 0}.meta{color:#666;font-size:13px}</style></head><body>"
939         "<h1>%s</h1>"
940         "<h2>Goal</h2><p>%s</p>"
941         "<h2>Path</h2><p>%d of %d steps done%s</p><ul>%s</ul>"
942         "<h2>Status</h2><p>%s</p>"
943         "<h2>Waiting on</h2><p>%s</p>"
944         "<h2>Open decisions</h2><p>%s</p>"
945         "<h2>Last change</h2><p>%s</p>"
946         "<p class=\"meta\">This page is read-only and carries no conversation or files.</p></body></html>") % (
947         e(m.get("name")), e(m.get("name")),
948         e(m.get("goal") or "(no goal recorded)"),
949         sum(1 for s in shown if s.get("status") == "done"), len(shown),
950         (" \u00b7 now: " + e(focused.get("name"))) if focused else "", "".join(rows),
951         e(lead),
952         e(waiting) if waiting else "nothing waiting",
953         e(" \u00b7 ".join(decisions)) if decisions else "none open",
954         ("last status " + e(at)) if at else "no status recorded")

957 def note_goal_receipt(cdir, goal, text, receipt):
958     """A verb said inside a goal's place and applied by the Campaign's writer: his words and the receipt go into the
959     goal's thread — the one log, tagged — so the answer appears where he spoke (Grok W2, missing). Marked as the
960     writer's receipt, never as the steward's speech. Best-effort: a history error never undoes the act."""
961     try:
962         from steward_cockpit.conversation_history import append_turns
963         append_turns(cdir, [{"role": "john", "text": text, "goal": goal, "via": "campaign_act"},
964                             {"role": "steward", "text": receipt, "goal": goal, "via": "campaign_act"}])
965         return True
966     except Exception:
967         return False

970 def handle_get(cdir, verb, qs):
971     if verb == "notebook-status":
972         import anchor_notebooks

1038             import office_preview as _op

1145 def events(cdir, qs):
1146     eng = get_engine(cdir, qs.get("general") == "1", qs.get("term"))
1147     if eng is None:
1148         return {"error": "no such session"}, 404
1149     try:
1150         since = int(qs.get("since", "0"))
1151     except (ValueError, TypeError):
1152         since = 0
1153     # SOFT START (John, 2026-08-26: opened the JCR tile after a restart and
1154     # the dialog was EMPTY — no pickup, no pending question). The pickup
1155     # machinery all lived inside wake(), but nothing called wake() on OPEN;
1156     # before the cutover engines simply stayed alive in RAM, so the gap only
1157     # shows after a service restart. Opening the page IS the wake for a
1158     # PARKED steward session: resume it so the deterministic pickup lines +
1159     # the model's brief orientation land on first poll. Guards: never for
1160     # workbench terminals, never for a brand-new effort (no stored session —
1161     # a mere page view must not spawn a fresh model session), only on the
1162     # open poll (since=0), single-flight via wake()'s own lock, and a 60s
1163     # cooldown so a wake that keeps failing can't respawn every poll.
1164     if since == 0 and not eng.general and not eng.alive():
1165         from steward_cockpit.steward_engine import _read_state_entry
1166         now = time.time()
1167         entry = _read_state_entry(eng.skey())
1168         has_durable_work = (entry.get("session_id")
1169                             or entry.get("pending_queue"))
1170         from steward_cockpit import maintenance
1171         if (getattr(eng, "_auto_wake_at", 0) + 60 < now
1172                 and has_durable_work and not maintenance.is_active()):
1173             eng._auto_wake_at = now
1174             try:
1175                 eng.wake()
1176             except Exception as exc:
1177                 eng._emit({"t": "sys", "text":
1178                            "automatic wake failed: " + type(exc).__name__})
1179     evs, oldest, gap = eng.events_since(since, timeout=8)
1180     return {"events": evs, "state": _state_with_usage(eng, cdir), "oldest_seq": oldest,
1181             "gap": gap, "stamp": campaign.map_stamp(cdir)}, 200

1207 def _gandalf_runs(cdir):
1208     runs, gdir = [], Path(cdir) / "gandalf"
1209     if not gdir.is_dir():
1210         return runs
1211     for rd in sorted(gdir.iterdir(), reverse=True):
1212         if not rd.name.startswith("run-") or not rd.is_dir():
1213             continue
1214         summary = ""
1215         for cand in ("exec-summary.md", "report.md"):
1216             try:
1217                 summary = (rd / cand).read_text(encoding="utf-8",
1218                                                 errors="replace")[:2600]
1219                 break
1220             except OSError:
1221                 continue
1222         finding, points = "", []
1223         m = re.search(r"^\**Bottom line:?\**[:\s]*(.+)$", summary,
1224                       re.MULTILINE | re.IGNORECASE)
1225         if m:
1226             finding = m.group(1).strip()
1227         try:
1228             adv = json.loads((rd / "advisor-output.json").read_text(
1229                 encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
1230             for f in (adv.get("findings") or [])[:3]:
1231                 if isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("verdict"):
1232                     points.append(" ".join(str(f["verdict"]).replace("**", "").split())[:260])
1233             if not finding and points:
1234                 finding = points[0]
1235         except Exception:
1236             pass
1237         try:
1238             ts = int(rd.name.split("-")[1]) / 1000
1239             when = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d", time.localtime(ts))
1240         except Exception:
1241             when = ""
1242         runs.append({"id": rd.name, "when": when, "summary": summary,
1243                      "finding": finding[:230], "points": points,
1244                      "report_rel": f"gandalf/{rd.name}/report.md"
1245                         if (rd / "report.md").is_file() else "",
1246                      "exec_rel": f"gandalf/{rd.name}/exec-summary.md"
1247                         if (rd / "exec-summary.md").is_file() else ""})
1248         if len(runs) >= 8:
1249             break
1250     return runs

1253 # The content types a deliverable is served under (ext → (ctype, disposition)).
1254 # "inline" lets the browser render what it can (PDF, images, plain text);
1255 # "attachment" hands the rest to the native app under the file's own name.
1256 # html/svg are served INERT as text (active content from a project folder
1257 # must never execute in the dashboard's origin).
1258 OFFICE_PREVIEW_EXTENSIONS = {".docx", ".pptx", ".xlsx"}
1259 _DELIVERABLE_TYPES = {
1260     ".pdf": ("application/pdf", "inline"),
1261     ".png": ("image/png", "inline"), ".jpg": ("image/jpeg", "inline"),
1262     ".jpeg": ("image/jpeg", "inline"), ".gif": ("image/gif", "inline"),
1263     ".webp": ("image/webp", "inline"),
1264     ".json": ("application/json; charset=utf-8", "inline"),
1265     ".md": ("text/plain; charset=utf-8", "inline"), ".txt": ("text/plain; charset=utf-8", "inline"),
1266     ".csv": ("text/plain; charset=utf-8", "inline"), ".log": ("text/plain; charset=utf-8", "inline"),
1267     # (2026-09-06, John: "I just see the raw code") HTML and SVG RENDER — served as
1268     # their real types under a Content-Security-Policy sandbox (see sandbox_csp_for):
1269     # an opaque origin that cannot read the dashboard's token, cookies or storage.
1270     ".html": ("text/html; charset=utf-8", "inline"), ".htm": ("text/html; charset=utf-8", "inline"),
1271     ".svg": ("image/svg+xml", "inline"),
1272     ".docx": ("application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document", "attachment"),
1273     ".pptx": ("application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation", "attachment"),
1274     ".xlsx": ("application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", "attachment"),
1275     ".doc": ("application/msword", "attachment"),
1276     ".ppt": ("application/vnd.ms-powerpoint", "attachment"),
1277     ".xls": ("application/vnd.ms-excel", "attachment"),
1278     ".zip": ("application/zip", "attachment"),
1279 }
1280 
1281 
1282 #: The sandbox a project's own HTML/SVG renders under: scripts may run, popups and forms
1283 #: work, but the document has an OPAQUE origin — no allow-same-origin, so it can never
1284 #: read the dashboard's localStorage token, cookies, or call the API as the user.
1285 SANDBOX_CSP = "sandbox allow-scripts allow-popups allow-forms allow-modals allow-downloads"
1286 
1287 
1288 def sandbox_csp_for(ctype):
1289     """The CSP header value for a content type that can carry active content, else None."""
1290     c = str(ctype or "").lower()
1291     if c.startswith("text/html") or c.startswith("image/svg"):
1292         return SANDBOX_CSP
1293     return None
1294 
1295 
1296 def deliverable_content_type(ext):
1297     """(content_type, disposition) for a deliverable's extension — total."""
1298     return _DELIVERABLE_TYPES.get(str(ext or "").lower(), ("application/octet-stream", "attachment"))

1306 def _deliverables(cdir):
1307     from steward_cockpit.steward_engine import _read_all_state
1308     estate = _read_all_state()
1309     live = {os.path.realpath(str(Path(cdir) / e["rel"]) if e["rel"] else cdir)
1310             for e in campaign.discover_efforts(cdir)}
1311     seen, out = set(), []
1312     for key, entry in estate.items():
1313         base = key.split("||")[0]
1314         if os.path.realpath(base) not in live:
1315             continue
1316         src = (CONFIG["steward"] if "||general||" not in key
1317                else _load_terms(base).get(key.rsplit("||", 1)[-1], {})
1318                     .get("label", "term"))
1319         effort = Path(base).name
1320         for f in entry.get("files", []):
1321             if f in seen:
1322                 continue
1323             seen.add(f)
1324             try:
1325                 mt = int(os.stat(f).st_mtime); exists = True
1326             except OSError:
1327                 mt, exists = 0, False
1328             try:
1329                 rel_path = os.path.relpath(f, base).replace(os.sep, "/")
1330             except ValueError:
1331                 continue
1332             if rel_path.startswith(".."):
1333                 continue
1334             out.append({"dir": "" if base == cdir else effort, "path": rel_path,
1335                         "name": Path(f).name, "effort": effort, "src": src,
1336                         "mtime": mt, "exists": exists})
1337     out.sort(key=lambda x: x["mtime"], reverse=True)
1338     return out[:80]

1341 def _files(cdir, sub, q):
1342     base = os.path.realpath(cdir)
1343     target = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(cdir, sub)) if sub else base
1344     if target != base and not target.startswith(base + os.sep):
1345         return {"error": "outside the effort"}, 400
1346     entries = []
1347     if q:
1348         hits = 0
1349         for root_, dirs, files_ in os.walk(base):
1350             dirs[:] = [x for x in dirs if not x.startswith((".", "_"))
1351                        and x not in ("node_modules", "vendor")]
1352             if root_[len(base):].count(os.sep) > 5:
1353                 dirs[:] = []; continue
1354             for name in files_:
1355                 if name.startswith((".", "_")):
1356                     continue
1357                 if q in name.lower():
1358                     full = os.path.join(root_, name)
1359                     try:
1360                         st_ = os.stat(full); size, mt = st_.st_size, st_.st_mtime
1361                     except OSError:
1362                         size, mt = 0, 0
1363                     entries.append({"name": os.path.relpath(full, base).replace(os.sep, "/"),
1364                                     "dir": False, "size": size, "mtime": int(mt)})
1365                     hits += 1
1366                     if hits >= 300:
1367                         break
1368             if hits >= 300:
1369                 break
1370     else:
1371         try:
1372             for name in sorted(os.listdir(target))[:250]:
1373                 if name.startswith(".") or name in ("node_modules", "__pycache__",
1374                                                     "vendor"):
1375                     continue
1376                 full = os.path.join(target, name)
1377                 isdir = os.path.isdir(full)
1378                 try:
1379                     st_ = os.stat(full); size, mt = st_.st_size, st_.st_mtime
1380                 except OSError:
1381                     size, mt = 0, 0
1382                 entries.append({"name": name, "dir": isdir, "size": size,
1383                                 "mtime": int(mt)})
1384         except OSError as e:
1385             return {"error": str(e)}, 500
1386     import anchor_notebooks
1387     for entry in entries:
1388         if not entry["dir"]:
1389             rel = entry["name"] if q or not sub else sub.replace("\\", "/") + "/" + entry["name"]
1390             info = anchor_notebooks.describe(cdir, rel)
1391             if info:
1392                 entry["notebook_product"] = info
1393     return {"sub": sub, "q": q, "entries": entries}, 200

1396 def _filetext(cdir, fpath):
1397     parts = [x for x in re.split(r"[\\/]+", fpath) if x]
1398     if not parts or any(_bad_component(x) for x in parts):
1399         return {"error": "bad path"}, 400
1400     base = os.path.realpath(cdir)
1401     target = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(cdir, fpath))
1402     if target != base and not target.startswith(base + os.sep):
1403         return {"error": "outside the effort"}, 400
1404     if not target.lower().endswith((".md", ".txt", ".json", ".csv", ".log")):
1405         return {"error": "not a text report"}, 415
1406     try:
1407         return {"text": Path(target).read_text(encoding="utf-8",
1408                                                errors="replace")[:400_000]}, 200
1409     except OSError as e:
1410         return {"error": str(e)}, 404

1414 def handle_post(cdir, verb, body):
1415     if verb == "refinement-accept":
1416         from steward_cockpit.refinement_client import update
1417         import uuid
1418         current = campaign.read_refinement(cdir)
1419         if not current or not current.get("ok"):
1420             return {"ok": False, "error": "refinement-state-unavailable"}, 409
1421         sl = current["state"]["slices"].get(str(body.get("step_id")), {})
1422         presentation = next((p for p in sl.get("presentations", []) if p["id"] == body.get("presentation_id")), {})

1659 def _upload_version(st_):
1660     """Return an opaque optimistic-concurrency token for one file identity."""
1661     fields = (
1662         "v1", getattr(st_, "st_dev", 0), getattr(st_, "st_ino", 0),
1663         st_.st_mode, st_.st_size, getattr(st_, "st_mtime_ns", 0),
1664         getattr(st_, "st_ctime_ns", 0),
1665     )
1666     raw = "\0".join(str(value) for value in fields).encode("ascii")
1667     return "v1-" + hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
1668 
1669 
1670 def _upload_snapshot(dst, incoming):
1671     """Describe a stable existing target, reading bytes only when sizes match."""
1672     for _attempt in range(2):
1673         before = dst.stat()
1674         version = _upload_version(before)
1675         same = False
1676         if stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_size == len(incoming):
1677             existing = dst.read_bytes()
1678             after = dst.stat()
1679             if _upload_version(after) != version:
1680                 continue
1681             same = existing == incoming
1682         return ({"ok": False, "exists": True, "name": dst.name,
1683                  "same": same, "size": before.st_size,
1684                  "mtime": int(before.st_mtime),
1685                  "incoming_size": len(incoming), "version": version}, before)
1686     raise OSError("target changed while it was being inspected")
1687

1689 def _stage_upload(folder, data):
1690     """Durably stage bytes beside their destination for atomic publication."""
1691     fd, raw_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=_UPLOAD_TEMP_PREFIX, suffix=".tmp",
1692                                     dir=folder)
1693     stream = None
1694     try:
1695         stream = os.fdopen(fd, "wb")
1696         fd = None
1697         with stream:
1698             stream.write(data)
1699             stream.flush()
1700             os.fsync(stream.fileno())
1701         return Path(raw_path)
1702     except Exception:
1703         if fd is not None:
1704             os.close(fd)
1705         try:
1706             os.unlink(raw_path)
1707         except OSError:
1708             pass
1709         raise

1712 def _discard_upload_stage(staged):
1713     if staged is None:
1714         return
1715     try:
1716         staged.unlink()
1717     except FileNotFoundError:
1718         pass

1721 def _upload(cdir, body):
1722     name = Path(str(body.get("name", ""))).name
1723     mode = body.get("mode", "new")
1724     sub = str(body.get("sub", "") or "")
1725     if not isinstance(mode, str) or mode not in _UPLOAD_MODES:
1726         return {"ok": False, "error": "unknown upload mode"}, 400
1727     if _bad_component(name):
1728         return {"ok": False, "error": "bad file name"}, 400
1729     if Path(name).suffix.lower() in DENY_UPLOAD_EXT:
1730         return {"ok": False, "error": "that file type can't be loaded in"}, 400
1731     if sub and any(_bad_component(p) for p in re.split(r"[\\/]+", sub) if p):
1732         return {"ok": False, "error": "bad folder"}, 400
1733     base = os.path.realpath(cdir)
1734     folder = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(cdir, sub)) if sub else base
1735     if folder != base and not folder.startswith(base + os.sep):
1736         return {"ok": False, "error": "outside the effort"}, 400
1737     try:
1738         data = base64.b64decode(body.get("data_b64", ""), validate=True)
1739     except Exception:
1740         return {"ok": False, "error": "bad file data"}, 400
1741     if len(data) > 30_000_000:
1742         return {"ok": False, "error": "over 30 MB"}, 413
1743     dst = Path(folder) / name
1744     final = os.path.realpath(dst)
1745     if final != base and not final.startswith(base + os.sep):
1746         return {"ok": False, "error": "refused (link escapes effort)"}, 400
1747     if os.path.islink(dst):
1748         return {"ok": False, "error": "refused (target is a link)"}, 400
1749 
1750     if mode == "replace":
1751         expected = body.get("if_match")
1752         if not isinstance(expected, str) or not expected:
1753             return {"ok": False, "error":
1754                     "replace requires the version from the conflict review"}, 428
1755 
1756     staged = None
1757     try:
1758         staged = _stage_upload(folder, data)
1759     except OSError:
1760         return {"ok": False, "error": "couldn't stage that file"}, 500
1761 
1762     published = None
1763     try:
1764         with UPLOAD_LOCK:
1765             # Re-assert link safety after staging, immediately before publish.
1766             if os.path.islink(dst):
1767                 return {"ok": False,
1768                         "error": "refused (target is a link)"}, 400
1769 
1770             if mode == "replace":
1771                 try:
1772                     conflict, current = _upload_snapshot(dst, data)
1773                 except FileNotFoundError:
1774                     return {"ok": False, "exists": False,
1775                             "error": "the reviewed file is no longer there"}, 412
1776                 except OSError:
1777                     return {"ok": False, "error":
1778                             "the file changed while it was being reviewed"}, 409
1779                 if not stat.S_ISREG(current.st_mode):
1780                     return {"ok": False, "exists": True,
1781                             "error": "the existing target is not a file"}, 409
1782                 if expected != conflict["version"]:
1783                     conflict["error"] = (
1784                         "the file changed after conflict review; review it again")
1785                     return conflict, 412
1786                 os.chmod(staged, stat.S_IMODE(current.st_mode))
1787                 os.replace(staged, dst)
1788                 staged = None
1789                 published = dst
1790 
1791             elif mode == "new":
1792                 # A hard-link publish is atomic and fails if another caller (or
1793                 # process) claimed the name; it can never overwrite that file.
1794                 for _attempt in range(3):
1795                     try:
1796                         os.link(staged, dst)
1797                         published = dst
1798                         break
1799                     except FileExistsError:
1800                         if os.path.islink(dst):
1801                             return {"ok": False, "error":
1802                                     "refused (target is a link)"}, 400
1803                         try:
1804                             conflict, _current = _upload_snapshot(dst, data)
1805                             return conflict, 200
1806                         except FileNotFoundError:
1807                             continue
1808                         except OSError:
1809                             return {"ok": False, "error":
1810                                     "the file changed while it was being reviewed"}, 409
1811                 if published is None:
1812                     return {"ok": False, "error":
1813                             "the destination kept changing; try again"}, 409
1814 
1815             else:  # keepboth
1816                 stem, suffix = Path(name).stem, Path(name).suffix
1817                 candidate = dst
1818                 number = 1
1819                 while True:
1820                     try:
1821                         os.link(staged, candidate)
1822                         published = candidate
1823                         break
1824                     except FileExistsError:
1825                         candidate = Path(folder) / f"{stem} ({number}){suffix}"
1826                         number += 1
1827     except OSError:
1828         return {"ok": False, "error": "couldn't save that file"}, 500
1829     finally:
1830         _discard_upload_stage(staged)
1831 
1832     try:
1833         version = _upload_version(published.stat())
1834     except OSError:
1835         version = ""
1836     return {"ok": True, "name": published.name, "version": version}, 200

1839 def _validate_effort_name(raw):
1840     """Effort names are HUMAN names → ``(clean_name, None)`` or
1841     ``(None, error)``. Guarded because on 2026-08-25 a token-shaped paste rode
1842     into the new-effort prompt and became a live effort's directory name (the
1843     name IS the display name everywhere): refuse the configured Anchor token
1844     outright, and refuse anything shaped like a pasted secret/id — one long
1845     unbroken word mixing upper, lower and digits."""
1846     raw = str(raw or "")
1847     name = re.sub(r"[^\w\- ]+", "", raw).strip()[:60]
1848     if not name:
1849         return None, "give it a short name"
1850     tok = str(CONFIG.get("anchor_token") or "")
1851     if tok and tok in raw:
1852         return None, ("that is your Anchor access token, not a name - pick a "
1853                       "plain name (and consider rotating the token)")
1854     if (len(name) >= 24 and " " not in name
1855             and re.search(r"[A-Z]", name) and re.search(r"[a-z]", name)
1856             and re.search(r"\d", name)):
1857         return None, ("that looks like a pasted token or id - give the effort "
1858                       "a short human name (a few words)")
1859     return name, None
1860 
1861 
1862 def _new_effort(cdir, body):
1863     name, err = _validate_effort_name(body.get("name", ""))
1864     if err:
1865         return {"ok": False, "error": err}, 400
1866     d = Path(cdir) / name
1867     if (d / "ECGBERHT.md").exists():
1868         return {"ok": False, "error": "that effort already exists"}, 409
1869     d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
1870     (d / "ECGBERHT.md").write_text(
1871         "# Ecgberht — Face (campaign memory)\n\n## North star\n\n\n"
1872         "## Active effort\n\n- None yet.\n\n## Why next\n\n- Stand-up: John "
1873         "describes the effort; the steward drafts the goal and the map.\n\n"
1874         "## Human wait\n\n- John: describe this effort.\n", encoding="utf-8")
1875     return {"ok": True, "rel": name}, 200
